cypher: MATCH (n:Person {name: $name}) RETURN n.education AS education, n.profession AS profession LIMIT 1

question: Show the recorded aliases and MyNeta name for Rahul Gandhi.
cypher: MATCH (n:Person {name: $name}) RETURN n.aliases AS aliases, n.myneta_name AS myneta_name LIMIT 1

question: How many terms and which election year are recorded for Narendra Modi?
cypher: MATCH (n:Person {name: $name}) RETURN n.terms AS terms, n.election_year AS election_year LIMIT 1

question: Show the recorded number of sons and daughters for Rahul Gandhi.
cypher: MATCH (n:Person {name: $name}) RETURN n.nSons AS nSons, n.nDaughters AS nDaughters LIMIT 1

question: What council section and special responsibilities are recorded for Narendra Modi?
cypher: MATCH (n:Person {name: $name}) RETURN n.council_section AS council_section, n.special_responsibilities AS special_responsibilities LIMIT 1

question: Show the available profile properties for a person named Rahul Gandhi.
cypher: MATCH (n:Person {name: $name}) RETURN n.name AS name, n.age AS age, n.gender AS gender, n.profession AS profession, n.education AS education, n.aliases AS aliases, n.election_year AS election_year, n.special_responsibilities AS special_responsibilities LIMIT 1

question: Show the age, party name, and election year recorded for MLAs in Gujarat.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:REPRESENTS]->(ac:AssemblyConstituency)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State {name: $state_name}) RETURN m.name AS mla_name, m.age AS age, m.party_name AS party_name, m.election_year AS election_year LIMIT 10

question: Show Ministry nodes and their portfolio type.
cypher: MATCH (m:Ministry) RETURN m.name AS ministry_name, m.portfolio_type AS portfolio_type LIMIT 10

question: Show a few CriminalCase records with case number, FIR number, court, and status.
cypher: MATCH (c:CriminalCase) RETURN c.case_no AS case_no, c.fir_no AS fir_no, c.court AS court, c.status AS status LIMIT 10

question: Show recorded total assets and liabilities for BJP MLAs.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA {party_name: $party_name}) RETURN m.name AS mla_name, m.total_assets AS total_assets, m.liabilities AS liabilities LIMIT 10

question: Show recorded movable and immovable assets for MLAs in Delhi.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:REPRESENTS]->(ac:AssemblyConstituency)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State {name: $state_name}) RETURN m.name AS mla_name, m.movable_assets AS movable_assets, m.immovable_assets AS immovable_assets LIMIT 10

question: Show INC members with their age and profession properties.
cypher: MATCH (n:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(p:Party {name: $party_name}) RETURN n.name AS name, n.age AS age, n.profession AS profession LIMIT 10

question: Find BJP MLAs with recorded total assets above 100000000 and show their asset and liability properties.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA:Person) WHERE m.party_name = $party_name AND m.total_assets > $min_assets RETURN m.name AS name, m.total_assets AS total_assets, m.liabilities AS liabilities, m.movable_assets AS movable_assets, m.immovable_assets AS immovable_assets LIMIT 10

question: Find people with recorded liabilities greater than 50000000 and show their names and parties.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.liabilities > $min_liabilities RETURN p.name AS name, p.party_name AS party_name, p.liabilities AS liabilities LIMIT 10

question: Show people whose recorded number of sons is greater than zero, with their number of daughters.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.nSons > 0 RETURN p.name AS name, p.nSons AS nSons, p.nDaughters AS nDaughters LIMIT 10

question: Show people whose recorded number of daughters is greater than zero, with their number of sons.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) WHERE p.nDaughters > 0 RETURN p.name AS name, p.nDaughters AS nDaughters, p.nSons AS nSons LIMIT 10

question: Show cases with a recorded court and status, including their FIR and case numbers.
cypher: MATCH (c:CriminalCase) WHERE c.court IS NOT NULL AND c.status IS NOT NULL RETURN c.case_no AS case_no, c.fir_no AS fir_no, c.court AS court, c.status AS status LIMIT 10

question: Which BJP members hold Ministry portfolios, and what portfolio_type is recorded for each Ministry?
cypher: MATCH (n:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(p:Party {name: $party}), (n)-[r:HOLDS_PORTFOLIO]->(m:Ministry) RETURN n.name AS person_name, p.name AS party_name, m.name AS ministry_name, m.portfolio_type AS portfolio_type, r.role AS role LIMIT 10

question: Find BJP MLAs with total assets over 100000000 who have a linked case, and return assets, liabilities, case number, and court.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:FACES]->(c:CriminalCase) WHERE m.party_name = $party AND m.total_assets > $min_assets RETURN m.name, m.total_assets, m.liabilities, c.case_no, c.court LIMIT 10

question: What is the average recorded age of MLAs, grouped by party? Return aggregate values, not graph paths.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA) RETURN m.party_name AS party, avg(m.age) AS average_age ORDER BY average_age DESC LIMIT 10

question: For BJP MLAs, what are the average, minimum, and maximum recorded total_assets values?
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA {party_name: $party_name}) RETURN avg(m.total_assets) AS average_assets, min(m.total_assets) AS min_assets, max(m.total_assets) AS max_assets LIMIT 10

question: How many distinct people are linked to at least one CriminalCase, grouped by party?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(pt:Party), (p)-[:FACES]->(:CriminalCase) RETURN pt.name AS party, count(DISTINCT p) AS distinct_people_count ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: What are the average recorded numbers of sons and daughters for people, grouped by gender?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person) RETURN p.gender AS gender, avg(p.nSons) AS average_sons, avg(p.nDaughters) AS average_daughters LIMIT 10

question: How many BJP MLAs represent constituencies in each State? Return one count per state.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA {party_name: $party_name})-[:REPRESENTS]->(c)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State) RETURN s.name AS state_name, count(DISTINCT m) AS mla_count ORDER BY mla_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Which Section codes have the most linked CriminalCase nodes? Return counts sorted descending, with a small limit.
cypher: MATCH (c:CriminalCase)-[:UNDER]->(s:Section) RETURN s.code AS section_code, count(c) AS case_count ORDER BY case_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: How many people hold portfolios in each Ministry portfolio_type, and how many distinct people per type?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[r:HOLDS_PORTFOLIO]->(m:Ministry) RETURN m.portfolio_type AS portfolio_type, count(p) AS total_holdings, count(DISTINCT p) AS distinct_people ORDER BY distinct_people DESC LIMIT 10

question: For Gujarat MLAs, compare average total_assets, movable_assets, immovable_assets, and liabilities by party.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:REPRESENTS]->(c)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State {name: $state_name}) RETURN m.party_name AS party, avg(m.total_assets) AS avg_total_assets, avg(m.movable_assets) AS avg_movable_assets, avg(m.immovable_assets) AS avg_immovable_assets, avg(m.liabilities) AS avg_liabilities ORDER BY avg_total_assets DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each party, count distinct MLA members, distinct linked cases, and cases grouped by status.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(pt:Party), (m)-[:FACES]->(c:CriminalCase) RETURN pt.name AS party, c.status AS case_status, count(DISTINCT m) AS distinct_mlas, count(DISTINCT c) AS distinct_cases, count(c) AS total_cases ORDER BY total_cases DESC LIMIT 10

question: Compare average MLA age and member count by party and State, using represented constituencies.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:REPRESENTS]->(c)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State) RETURN m.party_name AS party, s.name AS state_name, avg(m.age) AS average_age, count(DISTINCT m) AS member_count ORDER BY member_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Among BJP MLAs in Gujarat, compute average age and assets, count distinct linked criminal cases by status, and list the most common Section codes.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:REPRESENTS]->(c:AssemblyConstituency)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State {name: $state_name}) WHERE m.party_name = $party_name MATCH (m)-[:FACES]->(cc:CriminalCase)-[:UNDER]->(sec:Section) RETURN avg(m.age) AS avg_age, avg(m.total_assets) AS avg_assets, cc.status AS case_status, count(DISTINCT cc) AS case_count, sec.code AS section_code, count(sec) AS section_count ORDER BY case_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: Compare BJP and INC by State: number of MLAs, average age, average total_assets, number with cases, and distinct case counts.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:REPRESENTS]->(c:AssemblyConstituency)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State) WHERE m.party_name IN $parties MATCH (m)-[:FACES]->(cc:CriminalCase) RETURN s.name AS state_name, m.party_name AS party_name, count(DISTINCT m) AS mla_count, avg(m.age) AS avg_age, avg(m.total_assets) AS avg_total_assets, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.criminal_case_count > 0 THEN m END) AS mlas_with_cases, count(DISTINCT cc) AS distinct_case_count ORDER BY state_name, party_name LIMIT 10

question: For each party and Section code, count distinct MLAs linked through cases, then return the top ten party-section pairs.
cypher: MATCH (p:Party)<-[:MEMBER_OF]-(m:MLA)-[:FACES]->(cc:CriminalCase)-[:UNDER]->(s:Section) RETURN p.name AS party_name, s.code AS section_code, count(DISTINCT m) AS distinct_mla_count ORDER BY distinct_mla_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each Ministry portfolio_type and party, count distinct holders and count distinct holders who also have linked cases.
cypher: MATCH (m:Person)-[:HOLDS_PORTFOLIO]->(min:Ministry), (m)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(p:Party) RETURN min.portfolio_type AS portfolio_type, p.name AS party_name, count(DISTINCT m) AS total_holders, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.criminal_case_count > 0 THEN m END) AS holders_with_cases ORDER BY total_holders DESC LIMIT 10

question: Find parties whose Gujarat MLAs have average liabilities above 10000000; return average liabilities, total assets, and MLA count.
cypher: MATCH (m:MLA)-[:REPRESENTS]->(c:AssemblyConstituency)-[:IN_STATE]->(s:State {name: $state_name}), (m)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(p:Party) WITH p, m WHERE m.liabilities IS NOT NULL WITH p, avg(m.liabilities) AS avg_liabilities, avg(m.total_assets) AS avg_total_assets, count(m) AS mla_count WHERE avg_liabilities > $threshold RETURN p.name AS party_name, avg_liabilities, avg_total_assets, mla_count ORDER BY avg_liabilities DESC LIMIT 10

question: Among people with known age, profession, sons, and daughters, compare average age and family counts by profession and party.
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(party:Party) WHERE p.age IS NOT NULL AND p.profession IS NOT NULL AND p.nSons IS NOT NULL AND p.nDaughters IS NOT NULL RETURN p.profession AS profession, party.name AS party_name, avg(p.age) AS avg_age, avg(p.nSons) AS avg_sons, avg(p.nDaughters) AS avg_daughters, count(p) AS person_count ORDER BY person_count DESC LIMIT 10

question: For each State and party, rank MLA groups by average assets and case prevalence, while counting distinct constituencies and Sections.
cypher: MATCH (s:State)<-[:IN_STATE]-(ac:AssemblyConstituency)<-[:REPRESENTS]-(m:MLA)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(p:Party), (m)-[:FACES]->(cc:CriminalCase)-[:UNDER]->(sec:Section) RETURN s.name AS state_name, p.name AS party_name, avg(m.total_assets) AS avg_assets, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.criminal_case_count > 0 THEN m END) * 1.0 / count(DISTINCT m) AS case_prevalence, count(DISTINCT ac) AS distinct_constituencies, count(DISTINCT sec) AS distinct_sections ORDER BY avg_assets DESC LIMIT 10
